title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

The shock to MSFT from “Azure growth accelerates above 50%”

Microsoft has fallen from $554 on Nov 4 to $500 as outages and the software selloff hit it. A clear acceleration answers Dan Ives's 'six-month window' for AI to show monetisation; the shares rose about 6% on Nov 4 when investors rotated back to it. 5% beyond what the shares would otherwise do.
